summary: Cardens Bluff (Cherokee NF, Watauga Lake) checked on rec.gov (facility, rates, catalog, October calendar), the FS page, Esri and 3DEP: 40 sites, nearly all tent; site 29 is the one catalog RV site (30 ft), 28 also per the agency notice; no hookups, showers/flush toilets, hydrant water; $12; season 04-27..10-13; operating (Helene closed one bathroom). --AWH lakefront kept but measured as a bluff-top view; the stored pin is in the lake.
flags: WATERFRONT --AWH lakefront NOT changed; disagreement reported. Site 29 (rec.gov 36.313511,-82.117738, reservable by the night, the one RV site rated 30 ft) is on the bluff top at 610.9 m (3DEP); the ground drops to the lake surface (3DEP 595.3 m; summer full pool 1,959 ft = 597.1 m) in ~25-30 m to the NE/E, i.e. ~14 m above summer pool on a ~25-30 degree slope, under continuous leaf-off canopy on Esri. That fails the kayak test (pads 1-2 m above the edge); by the rules it is lakeview. The catalog does not tag 29 'Lakefront' at all; it tags 25 and 28, which are ~6-16 m above the water, 40-50 m back, and not rated for a 23-ft rig (25: trailer 20 ft; 28: RV length unset, 30 ft per the notice).

PIN: stored 36.3109,-82.1188 is in Watauga Lake (3DEP 595.28 m = water surface; Esri open water), ~190 m west of the site centroid. Suggest 36.3119,-82.1171 (centroid of the 40 catalog sites, on the peninsula; 3DEP ~614 m nearby). Stored elevation_meters 598 is the lake level; ~612 fits the campground.
PHONE: '' -> 423-735-1500 (Watauga Ranger District, on both the FS page and rec.gov).

INCLUSION (thin RV capacity): of 40 sites only 29 is catalogued for an RV of 23 ft+ (30 ft); 28 is 30 ft per the agency notice but has no length in the catalog; 16 is 30 ft per the notice but 20 ft in the catalog (max vehicle 20). One or two nightly sites for a 23-ft rig. Not a drop under the rules; worth knowing.

BOOKING: rec.gov site-specific reservations; holiday weekends carry a 3-night minimum (rec.gov rule minHolidayWeekendStay 3, not standing). FCFS not derivable; 'Self Pay Station' is in rec.gov's amenity list.
STATUS: closed for the season now (normal seasonal closure), reopens late April (04-27 in 2026); lower bathroom near site 36 out since Hurricane Helene.
